plan_name: MiniLinks Bookmark Manager Software Factory Orchestration Plan

structured_output.notes: Created comprehensive product and technical specification for MiniLinks conforming strictly to Python 3 standard library, SQLite, vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, 12-step deterministic smoke tests, and directory traversal security.
structured_output.summary: Created MiniLinks product specification in examples/minilinks/SPEC.md documenting SQLite schema, REST API contract, static file serving, create_server factory interface, testing harness, and responsive frontend requirements.

structured_output.notes: Standard library Python 3 only (http.server, sqlite3, json, urllib.parse). create_server() runs an HTTPServer in a daemon thread and supports both direct server reference and tuple unpacking (server, thread). Full SQLite persistence with bookmarks schema (id, title, url, notes, created_at, updated_at). Input validation for non-empty title and valid http/https URL. Path traversal protection for static files. CORS preflight support.
structured_output.summary: Implemented MiniLinks backend in examples/minilinks/app/database.py and examples/minilinks/app/server.py with SQLite persistence, REST API (/health, /api/bookmarks with ?q= filtering, /api/bookmarks/<id>), create_server running in a daemon thread, and secure static file serving.

structured_output.notes: Frontend provides a zero-dependency, vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and ES6+ JavaScript implementation with accessible modal dialogs, real-time debounced search against /api/bookmarks?q=, toast notifications, connection status monitoring via /health, and responsive styling for mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
structured_output.summary: Implemented MiniLinks web frontend in examples/minilinks/web/ (index.html, style.css, app.js) supporting bookmark creation, dynamic search filtering, edit modal, delete confirmation modal, and REST API communication via standard fetch.
